summary: Vale S.A. filed a Form 6-K containing its annual report on compliance with the Brazilian Code of Corporate Governance, base date 30/07/2026. The filing is a routine corporate governance disclosure, not a special-situation event. It discusses board analysis of a defensive measure requiring a tender offer if a shareholder reaches 25% of common shares, with minimum price terms including a 20% premium over market. No transaction, activist campaign, or strategic action is announced. This is a standard regulatory filing with no deal terms, so it does not qualify as a special situation.
